title: Grids that can move and balance clean power
description: The IEA estimates about 80 million km of grid lines need to be added or refurbished by 2040, and counted at least 3,000 GW of renewable projects waiting for grid connection in 2023. High-voltage lines take a decade or more to permit and build in many countries. Flexible demand and short-duration storage help balance what the grid carries.
